title: Average close per ticker
statementMd:
Average closing price per symbol rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `avg_close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, ROUND(AVG(close), 2) AS avg_close FROM prices GROUP BY symbol;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
